hypothesis: A high point-in-time Cboe Equity Put/Call Ratio contains short-horizon bearish information that can improve frozen V11 execution by postponing only positive U.S.-equity increments for one trading session, without changing V11 target sizing, risk reductions, non-U.S. trades, leverage, or long-run gross exposure.

literature_basis.motivation: Published option-market research reports that unsigned put/call ratios contain short-horizon predictive information for subsequent stock returns, with the economically relevant horizon concentrated at daily/near-daily frequency.
literature_basis.data_source: Cboe official Volume and Put/Call Ratio history plus explicit-date Daily Market Statistics pages
literature_basis.direction: higher put/call ratio is treated as a short-horizon bearish state; the candidate delays U.S. risk increases rather than increasing risk

allowed_changes: use the Cboe Equity Put/Call Ratio only from the stable equity-only definition beginning 2012-06-11; earlier observations are excluded because the official legacy file states that ETP exclusion begins on that date

use legacy Cboe equitypc.csv through 2019-10-04 and explicit-date Cboe Daily Market Statistics from 2019-10-07 onward, with every daily observation conservatively usable only when available_date <= execution date
begin interventions on 2013-01-01 after a fixed warm-up period that was chosen before strategy performance was viewed

high-put-call state iff the latest available ratio is greater than the expanding median of all strictly earlier stable-definition observations; the latest observation is excluded from its own threshold

on a genuine frozen V11 source event with a positive Nasdaq and/or S&P 500 target increment, a high-put-call state postpones only that positive U.S. increment by exactly one trading session; all reductions and all non-U.S. target changes execute immediately

on the next trading session, complete the delayed U.S. increment to the frozen V11 source-event target unless a new frozen V11 source event occurs first; a new source event cancels any stale delayed completion
selection_metric: No within-family selection. Compare the single frozen execution-timing candidate with frozen V11 and C-CBOE-PC-DELAY-ALWAYS. Primary inference uses the preregistered 2013-01-01+ common window; full-history metrics are reported for disclosure and cumulative DSR compatibility.
pass_fail_gates: deterministic: at least 5/7 fixed folds candidate Sharpe >= matched-control Sharpe
deterministic: target gross <=100%, min target weight >=0, no financing or shorting
bootstrap on 2013+ common window: paired circular moving blocks, 63 sessions, 20000 replicates, seed 20260822
PBO: not applicable because the family contains exactly one preregistered candidate
global post-protocol DSR probability >=95% using all prior 33 formal return-seeking candidates plus F-CBOE-PC-EXECUTION, total trial count 34
ROBUST_FACTOR_PASS requires every applicable deterministic, bootstrap, and global DSR gate
follow_up_policy: This campaign contains exactly one retrospective Cboe put/call execution candidate. After formal performance is viewed, do not change the 2012-06-11 stable-definition start, 2013-01-01 intervention start, sign, median definition, rolling window, percentile, z-score, delay length, Nasdaq/S&P scope, source-event definition, completion rule, cost assumptions, or matched control; do not open a second retrospective rescue family. A suggestive non-robust result may only enter a separately preregistered prospective shadow using this exact historical rule.
swift_engine_entrypoint: scripts/run_cboe_equity_put_call_execution_v1.py -> tools/cboe_equity_put_call_execution_v1.swiftpart + tools/cboe_equity_put_call_execution_v1_logic.swift -> frozen V11 source run + BacktestEngine.runResearchTargetProviderStrategyWithTrace -> shared BacktestDailySimulator
expected_outputs: V11-CONTROL full-history metrics and frozen target fingerprint
factor-library archival with truthful lifecycle after the formal result
run authorization receipt, execution Git commit and SHA-256 result artifact manifest

factor_definition.stable_start_reason: Cboe legacy file states that as of 2012-06-11 Equity Volume includes only equity option products and excludes exchange-traded products
factor_definition.modern_segment: explicit-date Cboe Daily Market Statistics from 2019-10-07 onward
factor_definition.availability: prior-close ratio is conservatively usable when available_date <= next execution date
factor_definition.high_state_rule: latest available Equity Put/Call Ratio > prior-only expanding median

execution_action.eligible_event: a genuine frozen V11 source event whose current target increases Nasdaq and/or S&P 500 relative to the previous frozen V11 source-event target
execution_action.high_state_action: execute all V11 reductions and non-U.S. target changes immediately, keep only positive Nasdaq/S&P increments at their prior-event weights for exactly one trading session, then complete to the current frozen V11 target on the next session
execution_action.normal_or_unavailable_action: execute the current frozen V11 event target immediately
execution_action.new_source_event_rule: if a new frozen V11 source event arrives on the scheduled completion session, cancel the stale completion and process the new source event

matched_control.rule: on every factor-available eligible U.S.-risk-increase V11 event, apply the identical one-trading-session U.S.-increment delay regardless of put/call state

forbidden_changes: any frozen V11 source, parameter, target sizing, or target path change
any sign reversal or alternate put/call family after results
any rolling-window, fixed-threshold, percentile, rank, z-score, persistence, smoothing, or multi-day confirmation search
any delay other than exactly one trading session
any delay of risk reductions or non-U.S. target changes
any asset scope other than positive Nasdaq/S&P increments
any leverage, financed exposure, or gross increase above frozen V11 target
candidate replacement or second retrospective Cboe P/C candidate after results
dropping failed prior formal candidates from cumulative DSR accounting

statistical_audit.global_dsr_return_window: full history for consistency with prior post-protocol DSR accounting

factor_library_archival.action_after_formal_result: archive factor definition, preregistration, formal result and evidence in FlyingrtxFast with truthful lifecycle status
factor_library_archival.robust_pass_policy: may advance only according to factor-library lifecycle and protocol gates
factor_library_archival.fail_policy: archive as rejected research evidence; never hide the failed trial
